local Repeat = require "actions/Repeat" local Serial = require "actions/Serial" local Ease = require "actions/Ease" local Do = require "actions/Do" local PlayAudio = require "actions/PlayAudio" local Animate = require "actions/Animate"
local SpriteNode = require "object/SpriteNode"
local Transform = require "util/Transform"
return function(self, dt) local tails = self.scene.objectLookup.Tails if tails.x < self.x + 100 and not self.touched and not self.scene.invincible then if tails.x > self.x - 3000 and not self.alert then self.alert = true
self:run { PlayAudio("sfx", "alert", 1.0, true), Animate(function() return SpriteNode(self.scene, Transform(700, self.y-232, 2, 2), nil, "alert", nil, nil, "ui"), true end, "idle") } end
if tails:isTouching(self.x, self.y, self.object.width, self.object.height) then self.touched = true self.scene.invincible = true
tails:run { Repeat( Serial { Ease(tails.sprite.color, 4, 0, 20, "quad"), Ease(tails.sprite.color, 4, 255, 20, "quad") }, 10 ), Do(function() self.scene.invincible = false end) } end end end

return function(self, dt) if not self.move then return end
